text: 财政部：香港强制性公积金受香港强制性公积金计划管理局监管，面向不特定客户提供标准化养老金融服务。根据《公告》第一条规定，不属于《公告》所称离岸信托。
text_en: Ministry of Finance: The Hong Kong Mandatory Provident Fund is regulated by the Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority of Hong Kong and provides standardized pension financial services to unspecified clients. According to Article 1 of the Announcement, it does not constitute an offshore trust as referred to in the Announcement.
